company_name.description: Issuing company as printed in the heading

authorized_capital.description: Capital stock amount printed at the top, as printed, e.g. '$125,000.00'

number_of_shares.description: Number of shares, from the figure in the Shares box

shares_in_words.description: Number of shares as written out in words in the body

par_value_per_share.description: Par value per share as written in the body, e.g. 'One Hundred Dollars'

residence.description: City and state or province written after 'of'

issue_date.description: Date in the 'Dated at ... this ... day of' line, as YYYY-MM-DD

signatories.description: Each signature line at the foot of the certificate

title.description: Printed title under the signature, e.g. 'PRESIDENT'

name.description: Name as legible in the signature

cancelled.description: true if the certificate carries a cancellation mark, such as 'Cancelled' written across it
